verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack that Shortwave blocks tracking/read pixels by default, nor documentation explaining transparently what it does with mail data beyond generic AI/integration features. In fact community evidence raises the opposite concern — a user quoting Shortwave's privacy policy allowing sharing of email content/metadata with third-party vendors, and another worried about sensitive data syncing to Shortwave's servers — but since no vendor claim about pixel-blocking exists to contradict, this is an unmet axis rather than a dispute.
